info.name: Restful-Booker API Tests
info.description: Functional, negative, contract, security and data-driven tests. Tests named KNOWN-BUG assert the CORRECT behaviour and are expected to fail until the defect is fixed.

exec: // Track every booking the suite creates so the runner can delete it afterwards.
try { const id = pm.response.json().bookingid; const a = JSON.parse(pm.environment.get("createdIds") || "[]"); a.push(id); pm.environment.set("createdIds", JSON.stringify(a)); } catch (e) {}

item.name: 01 Health & Authentication
HLTH-01 Health check responds
AUTH-01 Login with valid admin credentials returns a token
AUTH-02 Login with wrong password is rejected

exec: pm.test("KNOWN-BUG API-BUG-001: status should be 401 for bad credentials", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(401); });

item.name: AUTH-03 Login with empty body is rejected

exec: pm.test("KNOWN-BUG API-BUG-001: status should be 400 or 401 for empty body", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([400, 401]); });

item.name: AUTH-04 Login with unknown user is rejected

exec: pm.test("KNOWN-BUG API-BUG-001: status should be 401 for unknown user", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(401); });

item.name: AUTH-05 SQL injection in username does not authenticate or crash
02 Create booking
CRT-01 Create a booking with valid data

exec: pm.test("Echoes the submitted booking", () => { const b = pm.response.json().booking; pm.expect(b.firstname).to.eql("QA"); pm.expect(b.lastname).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("uniq")); pm.expect(b.totalprice).to.eql(150); pm.expect(b.depositpaid).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.bookingdates).to.eql({checkin:"2026-12-01",checkout:"2026-12-05"}); });

item.name: CRT-02 Create a booking without the optional additionalneeds field
CRT-03 Two creates return different booking ids

exec: pm.test("Id differs from the first booking", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().bookingid).to.not.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("bookingId"))); });

item.name: CRT-04 Malformed JSON is rejected with 400
CRT-05 Missing required fields are rejected with a client error

exec: pm.test("KNOWN-BUG API-BUG-002: should be 400/422, not a 5xx server error", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.within(400, 499); });

item.name: CRT-06 Empty object is rejected with a client error

exec: pm.test("KNOWN-BUG API-BUG-002: should be 400/422, not a 5xx server error", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.within(400, 499); });

item.name: CRT-07 Negative total price is rejected

exec: pm.test("KNOWN-BUG API-BUG-004: negative price should be rejected with 400", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.within(400, 499); });

item.name: CRT-08 Non-numeric total price is rejected

exec: pm.test("KNOWN-BUG API-BUG-004: string price should be rejected with 400, not stored as null", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.within(400, 499); });

item.name: CRT-09 Checkout date before checkin date is rejected

exec: pm.test("KNOWN-BUG API-BUG-004: checkout before checkin should be rejected with 400", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.within(400, 499); });

item.name: CRT-10 10,000-character first name is rejected

exec: pm.test("KNOWN-BUG API-BUG-004: oversized value should be rejected with 400/413", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.within(400, 499); });

item.name: 03 Read booking
RD-01 List all bookings
RD-02 Filter by lastname finds the new booking

exec: pm.test("Result contains the booking created in CRT-01", () => { const ids = pm.response.json().map(x => x.bookingid); pm.expect(ids).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("bookingId"))); });

item.name: RD-03 Filter by firstname and lastname together

exec: pm.test("Result contains the new booking", () => { const ids = pm.response.json().map(x => x.bookingid); pm.expect(ids).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("bookingId"))); });

item.name: RD-04 Filter with no match returns an empty list

exec: pm.test("Body is an empty array", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql([]); });

item.name: RD-05 Get booking by id returns the stored booking
RD-06 Get a non-existent booking returns 404
RD-07 Get a non-numeric id returns 404
RD-08 XML is returned when Accept is application/xml

exec: pm.test("KNOWN-BUG API-BUG-007: Content-Type should be application/xml, not text/html", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Content-Type")).to.include("xml"); });

item.name: RD-09 Invalid date in filter is rejected with a client error

exec: pm.test("KNOWN-BUG API-BUG-003: should be 400, not a 5xx server error", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.within(400, 499); });

item.name: RD-10 Error responses are JSON

exec: pm.test("KNOWN-BUG API-BUG-006: error body should be JSON, not plain text", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Content-Type")).to.include("json"); });

item.name: 04 Update booking
UPD-01 PUT with a token cookie replaces the booking

exec: pm.test("Fields are updated", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.firstname).to.eql("Updated"); pm.expect(b.totalprice).to.eql(200); });

item.name: UPD-02 Update is persisted

exec: pm.test("GET returns the updated values", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.firstname).to.eql("Updated"); pm.expect(b.totalprice).to.eql(200); });

item.name: UPD-03 PUT with Basic auth works
UPD-04 PATCH changes only the supplied field

exec: pm.test("Only firstname changed", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.firstname).to.eql("Patched"); pm.expect(b.lastname).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("uniq")); pm.expect(b.totalprice).to.eql(150); });

item.name: UPD-05 PUT without credentials is forbidden
UPD-06 PUT with an invalid token is forbidden
UPD-07 PATCH without credentials is forbidden
UPD-08 Forbidden update did not change the booking
05 Delete booking
DEL-01 DELETE without credentials is forbidden
DEL-02 Booking still exists after forbidden delete
DEL-03 DELETE with a token removes the booking
DEL-04 Deleted booking can no longer be read
DEL-05 Deleting an already-deleted booking returns 404

exec: pm.test("KNOWN-BUG API-BUG-005: should be 404 Not Found, not 405", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(404); });

item.name: DEL-06 Updating a deleted booking returns 404

exec: pm.test("KNOWN-BUG API-BUG-005: should be 404 Not Found, not 405", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(404); });

item.name: 06 Security checks
SEC-01 SQL injection in a filter returns no data and no error
SEC-02 Script payload is stored and returned as inert JSON text
SEC-03 Server errors do not leak stack traces

exec: pm.test("Body has no stack trace or file path", () => { const t = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(t).to.not.match(/node_modules|\bat .*\(.*:\d+:\d+\)|Error:/); });

item.name: SEC-04 Plain HTTP is redirected to HTTPS or refused

exec: pm.test("KNOWN-BUG API-BUG-008: HTTP request should redirect (3xx) to HTTPS", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.within(300, 399); });

item.name: SEC-05 Responses do not disclose the server framework

exec: pm.test("KNOWN-BUG API-BUG-009: X-Powered-By header should be absent", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.has("X-Powered-By")).to.eql(false); });

item.name: SEC-06 Empty token cookie is not accepted
90 Data-driven create
DD-01 Create booking from data row ({{firstname}} {{lastname}})

exec: pm.test("Echoes first name and last name", () => { const b = pm.response.json().booking; pm.expect(b.firstname).to.eql(pm.iterationData.get("firstname")); pm.expect(b.lastname).to.eql(pm.iterationData.get("lastname")); });

pm.test("Echoes price and deposit flag", () => { const b = pm.response.json().booking; pm.expect(b.totalprice).to.eql(Number(pm.iterationData.get("totalprice"))); pm.expect(String(b.depositpaid)).to.eql(String(pm.iterationData.get("depositpaid"))); });

item.name: DD-02 Created booking can be read back

exec: pm.test("Stored first name and last name match", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.firstname).to.eql(pm.iterationData.get("firstname")); pm.expect(b.lastname).to.eql(pm.iterationData.get("lastname")); });

item.name: DD-03 Clean up created booking
